fit: ground soybeans combined with levodopa and carbidopa
assessment: The original abstract reports longer ON time (p=.028) and less dyskinesia (p<.001) with ground soybeans alongside medication in seven people with Parkinson disease. It provides no refined soybean oil or separate resting-tremor comparison. Body and item results remain open.
